assertion: A 2023 NHTSA study found crashes directly cost taxpayers $30 billion, and society as a whole $340 billion. When quality-of-life valuations were included, the total cost to society ran to $1.37 trillion.
inaccuracy: The article says a '2023 study'; the NHTSA report (DOT HS 813 403, Feb 2023) measures 2019 crashes, so the figures are 2019 costs. The $340B economic cost is confirmed; the $1.37T wording was not found, only 'nearly $1.4 trillion'.
independent_value: NHTSA: $340B economic cost in 2019, total societal harm nearly $1.4T
